videos.title: Magnitude 7 earthquake kills 16 people in China’s Tibet, Xinhua reports
videos.description: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake kills at least 16 in Tibet as rescuers battle blocked roads, damaged homes and harsh mountain conditions.

videos.title: Inside Ukraine’s steel plant hit by Russian attacks
videos.description: Russian drone and missile attacks have forced Ukraine’s Kametstal steel plant in Kamianske offline, dealing a major blow to the country’s steel industry and economy.

videos.title: Tibet rocked by 7.0-magnitude earthquake
videos.description: Several surveillance videos show the moment a 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck China's southwestern region of Tibet, killing at least 16 people. The ​quake is the strongest to hit China since January 2024.

videos.title: Are Democratic Socialists Reshaping the Democratic Party
videos.description: Democratic socialists are gaining momentum in Michigan as Democrats grapple with a cost-of-living crisis, working-class voters and an ongoing identity crisis ahead of the midterm elections.

videos.title: Michigan voters closely divided between Rogers and El-Sayed
